principles: One declared authority per critical logical control family.
Version number in a live control filename is migration debt, not authority selection.
CURRENT means a current pointer/materialized projection, not a versioning scheme.
Existing version families may shrink; new sibling versions are blocked.
Legacy siblings may remain for history but must not become implicit fallback authority.
Stable unversioned authority names are the migration target; migration is separate and controlled.

current_rule.allowed: one logical CURRENT artifact per entity; multiple formats such as JSON+CSV are allowed
current_rule.blocked: new _CURRENT_vN or _Vn_CURRENT siblings, or new same-format CURRENT family conflicts
